report_identity.report_title: JH Educational Technology INC. 2023 Annual Report

business_overview.one_sentence: The group provides higher education and secondary education mainly through three schools in Zhejiang, China.

segments.business_substance: Higher education school enrolment at 31 December 2023
Higher education school enrolment at 31 December 2023
Secondary education school enrolment at 31 December 2023

business_overview.revenue_model: Tuition fees and boarding fees are generally paid in advance before the school year and recognised proportionately over the relevant programs.
business_notes: The 2021 PRC private school implementation rules require for-profit private schools to set aside at least 10% of audited annual net income as a development fund; non-profit private schools set aside part of annual net increase in non-restricted assets.
Structured contracts/VIE arrangements are used for PRC private education operations, with WFOE service fee and equity pledge/call option arrangements.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Detailed cash flow is available for 2022-2023 and shows operating cash flow above profit, helped by advance tuition/boarding receipts and contract-liability growth. 2021 detailed cash flow was not extracted in this run, so the three-year denominator confidence remains medium rather than high.

2023 annual report consolidated statement of cash flows, RMB'000

gaps: The annual report does not split cash and deposits by listed parent, offshore subsidiaries, WFOEs, VIE schools and operating schools.
The annual report does not quantify restricted school development fund balance as a separate cash line.

Only 2022-2023 detailed operating cash flow and capital expenditure were extracted from the 2023 annual report; 2021 detailed cash-flow statement was not separately downloaded because the request permits stock_report writes only to the 2023 target paths.
